title: SecondFi to shut down after $2.6M hack as recovery delays fuel backlash
summary: SecondFi, an ADA-based wallet service on Cardano, said it will shut down after about 16.1 million ADA, worth roughly $2.6 million, was stolen through an encryption flaw in its wallet software. The hack affected 374 wallets, and an investigation raised the possibility of links to Lazarus, a North Korean hacking group. As a result, the SecondFi and Yoroi wallet services will be phased out.The company had initially pledged to support asset recovery within two weeks, but affected users have pushed back after the launch of a zero-knowledge proof-based recovery tool and an asset transfer function was delayed to August.

title: BTC bottom still unconfirmed as rebound signals lag past turning points
summary: A clear bottom signal for BTC has yet to emerge, according to a CryptoSlate analysis. The media outlet said options market skew, the gap in implied volatility between call and put options, widened to 11.4 percentage points, while perpetual futures funding rates turned positive, suggesting investor sentiment and demand for leverage are recovering. Even so, those readings remain below levels seen in past bottoming phases. CryptoSlate added that investors who bought BTC during April and May, when funding rates were negative, had an average cost basis of about $77,900 and are now sitting on an unrealized loss of around 20%. The key variables for whether BTC extends its rebound or retests $58,500 are the July FOMC and BTC ETF fund flows.

title: Binance sees 9,030 BTC withdrawn in 24 hours, biggest daily outflow in 5 months
summary: A total of 9,030 BTC worth $589 million was withdrawn from Binance over the past 24 hours, marking the exchange’s largest daily Bitcoin outflow in the past five months, according to an analysis by on-chain research firm Ruga Research.Ruga Research added BTC’s 30-day momentum indicator had recovered from -21% to 0%, and over the past year, Bitcoin’s price repeatedly moved higher after similar patterns emerged. The firm said the latest large-scale BTC outflow is notable because it occurred during a momentum recovery phase rather than after a sharp price surge, calling it a signal market participants should watch.
